integrity: Exact finite-state rational certificate plus a mathematical proof of all-index gap exclusion and natural limiting frequencies; the checker is confirmatory and cannot alone prove the asymptotic statement.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to the zero-index set modulo three; known exact zero-set descriptions predate this result. The exact limiting gap law is a derived return statistic, and an earlier implicit or unindexed exact gap computation may exist. No independent mathematical assessment has occurred.
title: Exact six-gap law for ternary zeros of Stern's diatomic sequence
